<div class="card-body">
'''Rogue 3''' is a [[Light]] [[Vehicle]] ([[Combat Vehicle]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ローグ3</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">パイロットと乗客を合計で2名乗せられる。ウェッジが操縦しているなら耐：損耗＜3。ホスの位置に対してのみリアクションとして移動できる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Rogue-3-PSA-82917285.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">密閉型。ウェッジ・アンティリーズ中佐が操縦する。ウォーカーの脚を絡めることに成功。反乱軍がエコー基地を脱出する際に乗り捨てられた。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Rogue 3.

'''Card text:'''
May carry two pilots or passengers in total. Immune to attrition less than 3 if Wedge is piloting. May move as a react only to a Hoth location.

'''Lore:'''
Enclosed. Commander Wedge Antilles pilots it. It succeeded in tangling a walker's legs. Abandoned when the Rebels evacuated Echo Base.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Lore says it succeeded in tangling a walker's legs rather than “Successful walker tripper”, and uses 中佐.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Rogue 3]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
